defmodule Reminders do
  @moduledoc "Select pending reminders in input order; muted reminders are never sent."

  def batch(rows, limit) when is_integer(limit) and limit >= 0 do
    rows
    |> Enum.filter(&eligible?/1)
    |> Enum.take(limit)
  end

  defp eligible?(row), do: row.status == :pending and not row.muted
end

head_replacements.lib/reminders.ex:
defmodule Reminders do
  @moduledoc "Select pending reminders in input order; muted reminders are never sent."

  @doc "Return up to limit eligible reminders. Exclude IDs in :skip_ids before filling the batch."
  def batch(rows, limit, opts \\ []) when is_integer(limit) and limit >= 0 do
    skip = MapSet.new(Keyword.get(opts, :skip_ids, []))

    rows
    |> Enum.filter(&eligible?/1)
    |> Enum.take(limit)
    |> Enum.reject(&MapSet.member?(skip, &1.id))
  end

  defp eligible?(row), do: row.status == :pending and not row.muted
end
head_replacements.test/reminders_test.exs:
defmodule RemindersTest do
  use ExUnit.Case
  test "only pending, unmuted reminders are returned" do
    ready = %{id: 1, status: :pending, muted: false}
    assert Reminders.batch([%{ready | status: :sent}, %{ready | muted: true}, ready], 5) == [ready]
  end
  test "supports excluding IDs" do
    rows = for id <- 1..3, do: %{id: id, status: :pending, muted: false}
    assert Enum.map(Reminders.batch(rows, 3, skip_ids: [2]), & &1.id) == [1, 3]
  end
end
